title: Tiered launch communication matrix and privacy redaction
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Purpose: produce a single source of truth for internal and external release communications that (a) varies detail by customer tier, (b) enforces privacy and embargo redaction rules, and (c) integrates sign-off steps for Legal, Security, and Engineering. Deliverables: 1) tiered communication matrix mapping message, audience, owner, and embargo window; 2) redaction checklist and templated copy for high-risk items; 3) final internal brief and external changelog drafts (customer-facing summaries + technical release notes); 4) rollout timing and gated publish steps for Dedicated/Private customers. Constraints & trade-offs: balancing brevity for customers vs. operational detail for platform engineers; delaying public publish to allow security review increases time-to-release for some feature marketing. We will prioritize customer safety and regulatory compliance over same-day public notes when Legal flags items.
acceptance_criteria: Tiered matrix completed with owner for each audience (Public, Logged-in Customers, Dedicated/Enterprise)
Redaction checklist defined and applied to all sensitive items; Legal sign-off recorded
Internal release brief (1-page exec + 1-page ops) ready and shared at least 48 hours before public publish
External customer changelog draft ready and staged in CMS with embargo date configured
Localization tickets created for translations for EU/JP customers and estimates added to cycle

notes_and_decisions: Decision: Use tiered messaging where Public notes contain only high-level impact and benefits; Logged-in Standard gets a brief technical appendix; Dedicated/Enterprise receives a private technical bulletin with upgrade guidance.
Decision: Any item flagged by Legal or Security moves to 'embargoed' state until sign-off; embargoed items appear in internal brief but are redacted from public changelog.
Trade-off: Localizing the Enterprise bulletin doubles translation effort; we will localize public summaries first and provide Enterprise bulletins in English with offer to translate on-request.
